chapterInfo.content:
7
Adwamammɔ ne ɛso aba
1Me ba, di me nsɛm so,
na fa me mmara nsɛm sie.
2Di me mmara nsɛm so na nya nkwa,
na bu me mmara sɛ w’aniwa kurutuawisi.
3 # Mmb 3.3 Fa kyekyere wo nsateaa so,
twerɛ no w’akoma pono so.
4Ka kyerɛ nyansa sɛ: Me nuabaa ne wo,
na frɛ nhunumu sɛ w’adamfo,
5 # Mmb 2.16 na ahwɛ wo so afiri ɔbaa sansani ho,
afiri ɔbaa sansani a ɔka adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm ho.
6Na mefiri me dan mpomma mu,
m’aniahunuankansa mu mehwɛe;
7na mehwɛɛ ntetekwaafoɔ mu,
mehunuu mmɔfra no mu aberantewaa bi a ɔnni tire,
8ɔperee abɔntene bɛn ne ntwea,
na ɔsene faa ne fie kwan,
9ɛberɛ a adeɛ resa, anwummerɛ,
anadwo kɔnkɔn ne sum mu.
10Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi hyiaa no,
ɔfira adwamamfoɔ ntoma, n’akoma asene.
11Wagyigya na n’aso asoro,
ne nan ntena ne fie;
12seesei ɔwɔ mmorɔno so, seesei yi ɔwɔ edwa so,
na ɔtetɛ ntwea nyinaa so.
13Ɛnna ɔsɔɔ no mu, na ɔfee n’ano,
na ɔsenee n’ani ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ:
14 # Lew 3.3-4 Asomdwoeɛ afɔrebɔ da me so,
ɛnnɛ na mama m’aboadeɛ;
15enti na mefiri mebɛhyiaa woɔ yi,
mebɛhwehwɛɛ w’anim, na mahu woɔ yi.
16Mede mmomo makata me mpa so,
Misraim nkyeremu;
17mede kurobo ne pɛprɛ ne duapapo
mapete me nnaeɛ so.
18Bra ma ɔdɔ mmee yɛn nkɔsi anɔpa,
ma yɛmfa akɔnnɔdeɛ nsɛpɛ yɛn ho.
19Na efiewura nni fie,
watu kwan kɔ akyirikyiri;
20wafa fotoɔ ne sika akura,
srane korokumatwa da mu ansa na ɔbɛba fie.
21Ɔde bradɛ pii too no,
ɔde n’ano fremfrem nyaa no de no kɔe.
22Ɔdii n’akyi awerɛfirem sɛ nantwie a wɔrekɔku no,
sɛ mpokyerɛ a wɔde twe ogyimifoɔ aso,
23kɔsii sɛ agyan hwiree ne mmerɛboɔ mu,
te sɛ anomaa de ahoɔherɛ kɔ fidie mu,
na ɔnnim sɛ ne nkwa na ɛda mu.
24Na afei, me mma, montie me,
na monyɛ aso mma m’anomu nsɛm.
25Mma w’akoma mmmane nnkɔ n’atempɔn so,
mfom nkɔ n’akwan so.
26Na wapirapira nnipa pii agugu hɔ,
na wɔn a wakunkum wɔn dɔɔso;
27 # Mmb 2.18-19 ne fie ne Asamando kwan,
ɛsiane kɔ owuo mpia mu.

Me ba, di me nsɛm so,
na fa me mmara nsɛm sie.
Di me mmara nsɛm so na nya nkwa,
na bu me mmara sɛ w’aniwa kurutuawisi.
Fa kyekyere wo nsateaa so,
twerɛ no w’akoma pono so.
Ka kyerɛ nyansa sɛ: Me nuabaa ne wo,
na frɛ nhunumu sɛ w’adamfo,
na ahwɛ wo so afiri ɔbaa sansani ho,
afiri ɔbaa sansani a ɔka adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm ho.
Na mefiri me dan mpomma mu,
m’aniahunuankansa mu mehwɛe;
na mehwɛɛ ntetekwaafoɔ mu,
mehunuu mmɔfra no mu aberantewaa bi a ɔnni tire,
ɔperee abɔntene bɛn ne ntwea,
na ɔsene faa ne fie kwan,
ɛberɛ a adeɛ resa, anwummerɛ,
anadwo kɔnkɔn ne sum mu.
Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi hyiaa no,
ɔfira adwamamfoɔ ntoma, n’akoma asene.
Wagyigya na n’aso asoro,
ne nan ntena ne fie;
seesei ɔwɔ mmorɔno so, seesei yi ɔwɔ edwa so,
na ɔtetɛ ntwea nyinaa so.
Ɛnna ɔsɔɔ no mu, na ɔfee n’ano,
na ɔsenee n’ani ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ:
Asomdwoeɛ afɔrebɔ da me so,
ɛnnɛ na mama m’aboadeɛ;
enti na mefiri mebɛhyiaa woɔ yi,
mebɛhwehwɛɛ w’anim, na mahu woɔ yi.
Mede mmomo makata me mpa so,
Misraim nkyeremu;
mede kurobo ne pɛprɛ ne duapapo
mapete me nnaeɛ so.
Bra ma ɔdɔ mmee yɛn nkɔsi anɔpa,
ma yɛmfa akɔnnɔdeɛ nsɛpɛ yɛn ho.
Na efiewura nni fie,
watu kwan kɔ akyirikyiri;
wafa fotoɔ ne sika akura,
srane korokumatwa da mu ansa na ɔbɛba fie.
Ɔde bradɛ pii too no,
ɔde n’ano fremfrem nyaa no de no kɔe.
Ɔdii n’akyi awerɛfirem sɛ nantwie a wɔrekɔku no,
sɛ mpokyerɛ a wɔde twe ogyimifoɔ aso,
kɔsii sɛ agyan hwiree ne mmerɛboɔ mu,
te sɛ anomaa de ahoɔherɛ kɔ fidie mu,
na ɔnnim sɛ ne nkwa na ɛda mu.
Na afei, me mma, montie me,
na monyɛ aso mma m’anomu nsɛm.
Mma w’akoma mmmane nnkɔ n’atempɔn so,
mfom nkɔ n’akwan so.
Na wapirapira nnipa pii agugu hɔ,
na wɔn a wakunkum wɔn dɔɔso;
ne fie ne Asamando kwan,
ɛsiane kɔ owuo mpia mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
